💡 Dynamic-Island-Win11 | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To replicate the Apple Dynamic Island experience on Windows 11, enhancing music and media playback by providing at-a-glance information and controls.
✨ Key Features: • Displays music playback info (artist, title, album art) from Spotify, Yandex Music, browsers, AIMP, VLC, and other players. • Provides media controls: pause, skip, scrub.
📖 Summary: Dynamic Island for Windows 11 is a Rust-based application that brings Apple's Dynamic Island feature to Windows. It displays music playback information, synchronized lyrics, and other media controls in a compact, animated bar at the top of the screen, with options for customization and integration with various music players.
